summary: Completed frontend testing of Auditions page video playback requirements. All 5 user requirements verified through code review and UI testing. The key fix (removing isMuted from playback useEffect dependencies) is correctly implemented.

issues: Some videos show 'The element has no supported sources' error - this is a pre-existing S3 URL data issue, NOT related to video playback implementation

passed_tests: Requirement 1: Videos autoplay when appearing - useEffect triggers on isActive (line 217-253)
Requirement 2: Videos attempt sound by default - tries unmuted first (line 228), falls back to muted
Requirement 3: Click video pauses both video AND audio - togglePlay function (lines 280-291)
Requirement 4: Mute button mutes audio, video continues - separate mute useEffect (lines 273-278)
Requirement 5: Unmute restores audio synced with video - only sets video.muted property, no restart
isMuted defaults to false (line 860) - Volume2 icon shown initially
Playback useEffect only depends on isActive (line 253) - NOT isMuted
Mute state changes do NOT restart video - verified through code review
Mute button icon toggles correctly: Volume2 (unmuted) <-> VolumeX (muted)
Console logs confirm: 'Autoplay with sound prevented, trying muted...' - correct fallback behavior
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED FIX: isMuted removed from playback useEffect dependencies (line 253) - prevents video restart on mute toggle
Separate mute useEffect (lines 273-278) correctly handles mute state by only setting video.muted property
Autoplay implementation correct: tries unmuted first (line 228), falls back to muted (lines 233-239)
togglePlay function (lines 280-291) correctly pauses/plays video on click
isMuted state defaults to false (line 860) - sound enabled by default as per user requirement
context_for_next_testing_agent: Video playback requirements fully implemented and verified. Key implementation: 1) Playback useEffect (lines 217-253) only depends on isActive, NOT isMuted - this prevents video restart on mute toggle. 2) Separate mute useEffect (lines 273-278) handles mute state changes by only setting video.muted property. 3) isMuted defaults to false (line 860). 4) Autoplay tries unmuted first, falls back to muted if browser blocks. NOTE: Some test videos have broken S3 URLs - this is a pre-existing data issue, not related to playback implementation.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous bug: isMuted was in the playback useEffect dependency array, causing video to restart whenever mute button was pressed. Fix: Removed isMuted from playback useEffect dependencies (line 253) and created separate mute useEffect (lines 273-278) that only sets video.muted property without restarting playback.
